priorityList: Use Immolation Aura before combat begins and keep it active to generate Fury and trigger Ragefire.
Pick up Soul Fragments if Fury is below 40 to prevent resource starvation.
Cast Metamorphosis if Eye Beam is on cooldown or to trigger Fel-Scarred empowerments, ensuring you don't overwrite an existing Demonsurge proc.
Cast Reaver's Glaive whenever available, prioritizing targets to spread or maintain Reaver's Mark.
Prioritize using Death Sweep and Annihilation when their Fel-Scarred Demonsurge empowerments are active.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to trigger Demonic and Fel-Scarred transformations, ideally when Blade Dance is on cooldown and you are not in a priority window.
During Metamorphosis, use Essence Break when you have at least 35 Fury and Blade Dance is available.
Use Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative or Inertia buffs shortly before using Eye Beam or Essence Break.
Use Death Sweep (or Blade Dance) on cooldown as your primary priority Fury spender in AoE.
Cast Annihilation (or Chaos Strike) as a secondary spender, prioritizing targets with Reaver's Mark or during Essence Break windows.
Use The Hunt on cooldown, ideally aligned with Metamorphosis or when your primary target has Reaver's Mark.
Use Felblade to generate Fury, especially to trigger Inertia or if your Fury is below 40.
Tab-target your auto-attacks to spread the Burning Wound debuff if talented.
Use Fel Rush to trigger Inertia or as an AoE filler when other primary generators are on cooldown.
Use Throw Glaive as a filler to apply Soulscar or if you are out of melee range and cannot use Felblade.
